export_evidence: ImportKey (slug eimco-elecon-india-limited) buyer block: "52 NARAN MANDAL ENTERPRISES LLC — EIMCO ELECON (INDIA ) LIMITED, EIMCO ELECON INDIA LIMITED, SUITE NO.605-606 ... ULAANBAATAR MONGOLIA" and "28 SHUVUUN KHAR UUL LLC — EIMCO ELECON (INDIA ) LIMITED ... ULAANBAATAR MONGOLIA"; also "14 ARCOBALKAN D.O.O — EIMCO ELECON (INDIA ) LIMITED, 11080 ZEMUN-BELGRADE, SERBIA" and "12 MJC WORLD IMPORTS INC.". Counter: page header states "Total Shipments 601 Records detected" / "Trading Partners 10" / "Latest Cargo 2026-02-19"; rows actually visible on the free page: 5 import rows (dated 2026-02-19, 2026-02-13, 2026-02-06, 2026-01-16, 2025-12-16) plus 4 buyer-aggregate rows — no individual export B/L rows with date+destination+HS were rendered. Export direction is therefore evidenced only at counterparty-aggregate level (Mongolia, Serbia, Philippines buyers), not by a single dated export B/L line.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in (BSE: 523708 / NSE: EIMCOELECO) consolidated P&L: "Mar 2024 Sales 228" Rs Cr (Mar 2023: 173; Mar 2022: 84), i.e. audited domestic-plus-export turnover of ~Rs 228 Cr FY2024; company site eimcoelecon.in: "Eimco Elecon is a leading and established manufacturer and supplier of various Mining and Construction Equipment in India with operations supported by network of Sales and Service establishments located at various strategic locations throughout the country" and "EMTICI Engineering Ltd. is the marketing & servicing company for EIMCO ELECON (INDIA) LTD. products in India". Counter: 10 annual columns of sales figures seen on Screener (FY2015–FY2024); no GSTIN-level turnover band or GeM/CPPP tender award line was retrieved (search tool was down, so tender portal not queried).
note: Manufacturer (not a trader) of underground mining/construction equipment, Vallabh Vidyanagar, Anand, Gujarat — matches claimed state. Declared HS 842951/842959 (self-propelled front-end loaders / other earth-moving machinery) is broadly consistent with the product line (LHDs, side dump loaders, wheel loaders), but the customs rows actually visible on the free ImportKey page carry HS 84798999, 85444299, 85369090, 84314990 — those are the company's IMPORT lines (components from DANA Italia, BERCO S.p.A., Stonkam, Pempek Systems), not its exports, so no export HS code could be read directly. Export reality: real foreign buyers exist in customs data (Mongolia — Naran Mandal Enterprises LLC 52 shipments, Shuvuun Khar Uul LLC 28; Serbia — Arcobalkan 14; Philippines — MJC World Imports 12), which is shipment-record evidence rather than a website claim, but the free view does not expose a dated export B/L number, so the exact export B/L numbers and per-shipment HS codes are not public here — recorded as null rather than invented. Domestic supply is solidly confirmed by audited FY2024 consolidated sales of Rs 228 Cr. Revenue: FY2024 Rs 228 Cr (Screener, consolidated); export share of revenue not disclosed in retrieved sources — null. PAN AAACE4645C not verified in this pass (registries out of scope). No grounds for rejection: entity is listed and active.
